note: One entry per mosque key. The key is the folder name docs/athantimes/<key>/; clocks store it and download by it. Clocks list the entries in this order and show each by its name (plain ASCII, at most 40 characters, no two alike), so a mosque added here appears on every clock without a firmware update; owners never see the key. lat and lon are where the mosque is, in decimal degrees as a map shows them (colour-screen clocks show them under the name). "active": false keeps one off their list. tz is a POSIX time-zone string (copied into every yearly file). doha_after_sunrise and iqama_after (minutes) are only used by the scripts when a source has no Doha or no iqama column.
